frontier_status.summary: All locally available primary-source PDFs and bounded text passages in the Cycle 4 Stage 1 frontier have been exhaustively audited and curated (16 records in Round 120 PR #837 + 1 record in Round 121 PR #841 = 17 records admitted in Cycle 4 Stage 1, bringing data/records/ to 663 records). Every remaining candidate is either discredited/reclassified in the September 2026 IMA Master List (cesstibtantite -> hydrokenomicrolite / hydroxycalciomicrolite) or explicitly held pending unacquired external/paywalled primary papers (protasite, lepersonnite-gd, lokkaite-y, haiweeite, fourmarierite, masuyite, tsumoite; plus coalbed/coal-waste source issues #495-#498). Per cmmmech-add-record and cmmmech-discover-sources rules, source unavailability is an explicit hold rather than grounds for fabricated or abstract-only records. Therefore, the Cycle 4 Stage 1 bounded add_records frontier is exhausted (bounded_frontier_exhausted: true) while global scientific/mineralogical source exhaustion is not claimed (source_exhaustion_claimed: false).
